crossRefs.note: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you clean the outside of the cup and of the platter, but within…
You blind Pharisee, first clean the inside of the cup and of the platter, that its outside may become clean also.
“Hear this, house of Jacob, you who are called by the name of Israel, and have come out of the waters of Judah. You…
for they call themselves citizens of the holy city, and rely on the God of Israel; Yahweh of Armies is his name.
Yet they seek me daily, and delight to know my ways. As a nation that did righteousness, and didn’t forsake the…
if, when he sees the sword come on the land, he blows the trumpet, and warns the people;
holding a form of godliness, but having denied its power. Turn away from these, also.
looking carefully lest there be any man who falls short of the grace of God, lest any root of bitterness springing up…
“And to the angel of the assembly in Sardis write: “He who has the seven Spirits of God, and the seven stars says these…
“I know your works, that you are neither cold nor hot. I wish you were cold or hot.
So, because you are lukewarm, and neither hot nor cold, I will vomit you out of my mouth.

translations.web: Those who were foolish, when they took their lamps, took no oil with them,
translations.bsb: The foolish ones took their lamps but did not take along any extra oil.
translations.kjv: They that were foolish took their lamps, and took no oil with them:
translations.asv: For the foolish, when they took their lamps, took no oil with them:
